references.text: For if you forgive others their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you do not forgive others, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
Then you shall call, and the Lord will answer; you shall cry out, and he will say: Here I am. If you remove the yoke from among you, the pointing finger and malicious talk,
But this is what I commanded them, saying: Hear my voice, so that I may be your God, and you shall be my people. And walk always in the way that I command you, so that it may go well with you.
If I had cherished evil in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.

Be careful! If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him. And if he sins against you seven times a day, and seven times comes back to you saying, 'I repent,' then you shall forgive him.
Let us therefore pursue what makes for peace and for mutual upbuilding.
